if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_generic_priority = 1 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_generic_accept = 1 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_generic_shipped = 0 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_generic_quantity > 0 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_food_ratio > 0.9999 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_ratio > 0.9999 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_ratio > 0.9999 } }

if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_free > -0.0001 } NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_free < RUS_nat_generic_quantity } } NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_work < RUS_nat_generic_quantity } } check_variable = { RUS_nat_food_ratio > 0.9999 } }

subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_unit_price = 0.4 }
}

subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_units = 1 }

add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_price = RUS_agri_flax_market }
}
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_agri_saturation_flax }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_price = 0.15 }
}
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_price = 0.1 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_order_cash = 0 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_units = RUS_nat_eng_quantity }
while_loop_effect = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_units > 0 } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_unit_price = RUS_nat_price }
if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_sold < RUS_agri_flax_capacity } } }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_unit_price = 0.3 }
}
set_variable = { RUS_nat_tmp = RUS_agri_flax_capacity }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_tmp = 2 }
if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_sold < RUS_nat_tmp } } }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_unit_price = 0.4 }
}
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_unit_price min = 0.4 max = 1.5 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_order_cash = RUS_nat_unit_price }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_sold = 1 }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_units = 1 }
}
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_order_cash = 1000 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_income = RUS_nat_order_cash }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_work = RUS_nat_eng_quantity }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_left = RUS_nat_eng_quantity }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_actual = 1 } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_eng_shipped = 1 }
}
}
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_eng_crop = 5 } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_free = RUS_nat_textile_left }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_free = RUS_nat_textile_reserve }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_free > -0.0001 } NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_free < RUS_nat_eng_quantity } } NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_cotton_work < RUS_nat_eng_quantity } } check_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_ratio > 0.9999 } }

RUS_nat_award = {
set_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 0 }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_food_ratio > 0.9999 } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 2 }
}
else = {
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_food_ratio > 0.8999 } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 1 }
}
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_ratio > 0.9999 } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 0.5 }
}

add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 0.5 }
}

if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_food_left < RUS_nat_food_demand } } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 2 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_mean_coverage > 0.8999 } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 2 }
}

add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_diverse = 1 }
}

add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_diverse = 1 }

}

set_variable = { RUS_nat_task_done = 1 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_task = 3 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_diverse > 3 } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_task_done = 1 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_task_done = 1 } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 4 }

add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = 1 }
}
}
set_variable = { RUS_nat_score_fraction = RUS_nat_fraction }
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_maximalist_land_reform_success } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_score_fraction = RUS_nat_eligible_days }
divide_variable = { RUS_nat_score_fraction = RUS_nat_season_length }
}

clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_domestic_raw min = 0 max = RUS_nat_domestic_room }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_points = RUS_nat_domestic_raw }
set_variable = { RUS_agri_score_award = RUS_nat_points }
RUS_agri_credit_score = yes
set_variable = { RUS_agri_last_quarter_score = RUS_agri_score_award }
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_maximalist_land_reform_failure } OR = { has_country_flag = RUS_maximalist_land_reform_in_progress has_country_flag = RUS_maximalist_land_reform_success } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_domestic_year = RUS_nat_domestic_raw }
}
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_pp = 0 }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_food_ratio > 0.9999 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_ratio > 0.9999 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_ratio > 0.9999 } }

RUS_nat_penalties = {

}

}

}

RUS_nat_annual = {
set_variable = { RUS_nat_annual_average = RUS_nat_year_supply }
divide_variable = { RUS_nat_annual_average = RUS_nat_year_weight }
remove_ideas = RUS_agri_annual_shortfall
remove_ideas = RUS_agri_annual_surplus
remove_ideas = RUS_agri_annual_bumper_surplus
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_annual_average < 0.9 } }
add_timed_idea = { idea = RUS_agri_annual_shortfall days = 365 }
}
else = {
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_annual_average > 0.9999 } }
if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_food_left < RUS_nat_food_demand } } NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_left < RUS_nat_beet_demand } } NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_left < RUS_nat_textile_demand } } }
add_timed_idea = { idea = RUS_agri_annual_bumper_surplus days = 365 }
}
else = {
add_timed_idea = { idea = RUS_agri_annual_surplus days = 365 }
}
}
}
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_annual = RUS_nat_annual_average }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_last_annual = 100 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_year_supply = 0 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_year_weight = 0 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_domestic_year = 0 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_pp_year = 0 }
country_event = { id = RUS_national_agriculture.1 }
}

RUS_nat_settle = {
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_elapsed > 0 } }
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_agri_allocation_locked } }
RUS_nat_auto_allocate = yes
set_country_flag = RUS_agri_allocation_locked
}
set_variable = { RUS_nat_fraction = RUS_nat_elapsed }
divide_variable = { RUS_nat_fraction = RUS_nat_season_length }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_actual = 1 }
RUS_nat_yield = yes
set_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_work = RUS_nat_wheat_stock }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_work = RUS_nat_wheat_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_last_yield = RUS_nat_wheat_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_last_market = RUS_agri_wheat_market }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_work = RUS_nat_rye_stock }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_work = RUS_nat_rye_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_last_yield = RUS_nat_rye_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_last_market = RUS_agri_rye_market }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_work = RUS_nat_beet_stock }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_work = RUS_nat_beet_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_last_yield = RUS_nat_beet_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_last_market = RUS_agri_beet_market }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_work = RUS_nat_flax_stock }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_work = RUS_nat_flax_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_last_yield = RUS_nat_flax_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_last_market = RUS_agri_flax_market }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_cotton_work = RUS_nat_cotton_stock }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_cotton_work = RUS_nat_cotton_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_cotton_last_yield = RUS_nat_cotton_yield }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_cotton_last_market = RUS_agri_cotton_market }
RUS_nat_emergency_fill = yes
RUS_nat_consume = yes
set_variable = { RUS_nat_loss_rate = RUS_nat_wear }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_agri_weather < 0 } }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_loss_rate = 0.05 }
}
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_loss_rate = RUS_nat_repair_support }
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_loss_rate min = 0 max = 0.3 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_loss = RUS_nat_installed }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_loss = RUS_nat_loss_rate }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_loss = RUS_nat_fraction }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_installed = RUS_nat_loss }
RUS_nat_install = yes
set_variable = { RUS_nat_machine_work = RUS_nat_machine_stock }
RUS_nat_trade = yes
add_cic = RUS_nat_income
set_variable = { RUS_nat_machine_stock = RUS_nat_machine_work }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_income = RUS_nat_income }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_loss = RUS_nat_loss }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_weather = RUS_agri_weather }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_machine_market = RUS_nat_machine_market }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_season = RUS_nat_season }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_crop_orders = 0 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_last_crop_orders = RUS_nat_generic_shipped }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_last_crop_orders = RUS_nat_fra_shipped }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_last_crop_orders = RUS_nat_eng_shipped }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_machine_orders = 0 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_last_machine_orders = RUS_nat_fra_machine_shipped }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_last_machine_orders = RUS_nat_eng_machine_shipped }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_retention = 0.95 }
if = { limit = { has_idea = RUS_irina_kakhovskaya_advisor }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_retention = 0.98 }
}
set_variable = { RUS_nat_spoil = 1 }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_spoil = RUS_nat_retention }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_spoil = RUS_nat_fraction }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_retention = 1 }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_retention = RUS_nat_spoil }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_stock = RUS_nat_wheat_work }
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_wheat_stock min = 0 max = 12 }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_stock = RUS_nat_retention }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_stock = RUS_nat_rye_work }
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_rye_stock min = 0 max = 12 }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_stock = RUS_nat_retention }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_stock = RUS_nat_beet_work }
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_beet_stock min = 0 max = 6 }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_stock = RUS_nat_retention }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_stock = RUS_nat_flax_work }
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_flax_stock min = 0 max = 6 }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_flax_stock = RUS_nat_retention }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_cotton_stock = RUS_nat_cotton_work }
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_cotton_stock min = 0 max = 6 }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_cotton_stock = RUS_nat_retention }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_food_left = 0 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_food_left = RUS_nat_wheat_stock }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_food_left = RUS_nat_rye_stock }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_left = 0 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_left = RUS_nat_beet_stock }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_left = 0 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_left = RUS_nat_flax_stock }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_left = RUS_nat_cotton_stock }
RUS_nat_award = yes
set_variable = { RUS_nat_food_last_ratio = RUS_nat_food_ratio }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_food_last_ratio = 100 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_last_ratio = RUS_nat_beet_ratio }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_beet_last_ratio = 100 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_last_ratio = RUS_nat_textile_ratio }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_textile_last_ratio = 100 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_supply = 0 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_supply = RUS_nat_food_ratio }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_supply = RUS_nat_beet_ratio }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_supply = RUS_nat_textile_ratio }
divide_variable = { RUS_nat_supply = 3 }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_supply = RUS_nat_fraction }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_year_supply = RUS_nat_supply }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_year_weight = RUS_nat_fraction }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_boundary = 1 } }
RUS_nat_penalties = yes
RUS_agri_update_rotation = yes
RUS_agri_record_dominant_crop = yes
}
set_country_flag = RUS_nat_has_report
set_variable = { RUS_nat_elapsed = 0 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_eligible_days = 0 }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_coverage_sum = 0 }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_boundary = 1 } check_variable = { RUS_nat_season = 4 } }
RUS_nat_annual = yes
}
}
}

RUS_nat_daily = {
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_nat_enabled check_variable = { RUS_nat_last_day < global.num_days } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_last_day = global.num_days }
RUS_nat_production_day = yes
if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_quarter_end > global.num_days } } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_boundary = 1 }
RUS_nat_settle = yes
RUS_nat_start_quarter = yes
}
else = {
RUS_nat_refresh = yes
}
}
}

RUS_nat_deadline = {
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_nat_enabled }
RUS_nat_daily = yes
set_variable = { RUS_nat_boundary = 0 }
RUS_nat_settle = yes
RUS_nat_refresh = yes
}
}

RUS_nat_emergency_fill = {
if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_emergency_purchase = 1 } }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_emergency_need = RUS_nat_food_demand }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_emergency_need = RUS_nat_fraction }
multiply_variable = { RUS_nat_emergency_need = 0.9 }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_emergency_need = RUS_nat_wheat_work }
subtract_from_variable = { RUS_nat_emergency_need = RUS_nat_rye_work }
clamp_variable = { var = RUS_nat_emergency_need min = 0 max = 4 }
add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_wheat_work = RUS_nat_emergency_need }
set_variable = { RUS_nat_emergency_purchase = 0 }
}
}
